notes.title: We started working on Beta 2! | Thank you for your feedback
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28613334/4044d8bf6cbab858d9a25a0cb7af0f8b391c64ca.png[/img]

[h2]Heeeeeeeello Tube Tycooners![/h2]

It's been exactly 8 days since the first Beta for Tube Tycoon v2 released already! It's a blast seeing everyone enjoy the new update 🎉🎉

We asked you throughout this time to send us feedback and we appreciate each and every one submitted. We received over 250 reports - spanning from your first impressions to well constructed criticism which we all going to address! :TTprofessor:

Did you find a bug during your session? Whether you've got an idea for a cool feature, or simply want to share some positive word with us, the feedback form is always open [url=https://tally.so/r/w8QMlk][here][/url]

[hr][/hr]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28613334/299208047cc3edaf9d8c199f49c76d7990a26c45.png[/img]

Now time to go back to the life of a content creator and grab that Diamond TubeButton! :TealFire: See you in the next announcements!

notes.title: v2.0 Beta 1 is now available for everyone [JOIN BETA]!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28613334/5500405e09adea2d4dedc612e9449275a66999f6.png[/img]

[h2]The time has come...[/h2]

For the past years, thousands and thousands of people have been asking “Where is next Tube Tycoon update?”, “What happened to Tube Tycoon?”, “Is Bionicl dead?”. We hear you, we’ve seen the videos and as our hype-train finally arrives at the last stop, we think it’s finally time to share with you the most exciting news:

[h1]🔥 V2.0 Beta 1 is out!🔥[/h1]
[h1]We repeat, V2.0 Beta 1 is OUT!!![/h1]

That’s right! Right here, right now, the trip has finally come to an end after all this time filled with multiple announcements, weekly Feature Reveals and other sneak peeks. Welcome to station Tube Tycoon v2 Beta 1, thank you for choosing our hype-train and enjoy your stay 🫡

[hr][/hr]
[h2]But wait… what even is v2 Beta 1?[/h2]

Tube Tycoon v2 will be a [b]free update[/b] coming to Tube Tycoon! But before we get there, we will be rolling out betas allowing YOU to test out [b]new features[/b], catch any pesky bugs and [b]share feedback[/b]. In the meantime we will be collecting it and converting into better experience or other changes to make the last, official, [b]full[/b] Tube Tycoon v2 update the [b]BEST[/b] it can be! :TTProfessor: Quite a deal isn’t it?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28613334/d7c743ee5a8fc57a3968ee5bf53b93b0bede309e.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]
Over the last weeks we’ve shared multiple posts about upcoming features as our Weekly Feature Reveal. In case you haven’t seen these yet, check out the posts [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/TubeTycoon/announcements][b]➡️ HERE ⬅️[/b][/url] where each new feature or change has been described in detail!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28613334/29837f1cb2406821fc08c59463a4df9cc15ce1d0.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28613334/29837f1cb2406821fc08c59463a4df9cc15ce1d0.png[/img][/url]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Alllllright, enroll me for that beta![/h2]

Woah! Quite hyped, are we? That’s good, but what’s even better is that if you already have Tube Tycoon v1 you can try out beta [b]FOR FREE![/b]
You can start with following these 3 simple steps:
[olist]
[*]Find [b]Tube Tycoon[/b] in your Steam library
[*]Right click and select [b]“Properties”[/b]
[*]Go to [b]“Betas”[/b] tab and select the only option in [b]Beta Participation[/b]
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28613334/3cdb4e6df1641a6ee8faca8e19912d66ed62916c.gif[/img]

That’s it! The game will auto-update and as it finishes you will able to try out all the new features on your own!

[hr][/hr]
[h2]You can shape TT v2![/h2]

[url=https://tally.so/r/w8QMlk][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28613334/d2071ebf08593c47487276a05637dbf238a44c80.gif[/img][/url]

And that’s still not all! You can help making the Tube Tycoon v2 the best it can be by [b]sharing your feedback[/b]! Got any ideas for a new, cool mechanic? Maybe new feature doesn’t feel quite right in your opinion? Just want to show your support? Anything you want to share with us is welcomed! Simply click [url=https://tally.so/r/w8QMlk][b]➡️ FEEDBACK FORM ⬅️[/b][/url] to fill out the form or join our [url=https://discord.gg/TubeTycoon][b]➡️ DISCORD ⬅️[/b][/url] and we will make sure to address it :TTProfessor:

[h2]Thank you for being with us after all this time! Now go and grab that Diamond TubeButton![/h2]

[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28613334/0a02ab4c2836de6496009e6da74a284c6dde5094.png[/img]

notes.title: Recording games and TubeStim - coming to Tube Tycoon v2
notes.content:
[h1]Whaaaazzaaaapp Tube Tycooners!?[/h1]

It might be already a week since the “2024 Total Solar Eclipse” but we hope you didn’t throw your glasses into the bin yet, because it’s time to reveal this week’s [b]✨shiny✨[/b] new features of the upcoming beta! In case you missed the news, we are on the road to Tube Tycoon 2 [Beta 1] and each week we reveal new or redesigned features of the upcoming release!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28613334/0ac4e96ca0bd12f3ed5304e6f6bd8ebe78a17026.png[/img]

[h2]Ever felt like the games on TubeStim are boring? Time to say goodbye to that! :TealFire:[/h2]
TubeStim has been a part of Tube Tycoon from the very beginning.. after all you can’t record games if you don’t own them, so it deserved some change!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28613334/9d04fec8159698ba6c8f111e04a713da87c6d7d5.gif[/img]
[list]
[*]Fresh design with distinctive colors and icons for each game. Be sure to check out their new descriptions!
[*][spoiler]<In later betas>Even more games to record![/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]<In later betas> Games will now require additional "skill points" to be recorded. You gain skill by recording other games![/spoiler]
[/list]

[h2]And as for recording games...[/h2]
You’ve got so many of them but only 3 slots to record…well check this out! Now recording games lives inside the new [b]"Record" tab![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28613334/4ca68a374bd308041c0468037973028b1f791193.gif[/img]
[list]
[*]You can buy multiple games without the need of assigning a recording slot to them! Talk about a change!
[*]Each purchased (and not recorded game) awaits for it's start of a series
[*]You can record up to [b]4 games[/b] at once!
[*]Once you complete the game series, you will have an option to record a game review video
[/list]

[h2]And that’s it for this week’s Feature Reveal![/h2]
Hyped?! As expected, especially since the next Feature Reveal is going to be the last one, followed by the lo and behold - [b]v2 Beta 1 release![/b] Be sure to mark the date which is [b]🎉 24th April 🎉[/b] or join our [url=https://discord.gg/TubeTycoon][b]Discord[/b][/url] to not miss out and until the next announcement 🫡 Hype-train departures!

[h3][url=https://discord.gg/TubeTycoon][b]➡️ Tube Tycoon Discord ⬅️[/b][/url][/h3]

notes.title: Tasks and Storyline - coming to Tube Tycoon v2
notes.content:
[h1]Hello there Tube Tycooners! ːTubeTycoonː[/h1]

I hope everyone have seen the latest news: [b]Tube Tycoon is coming back![/b] For the next 3 weeks we will be uncovering features of the Tube Tycoon v2 that were either refreshed or totally new 🎉

And on August 24th you will be able to check it out [b]yourself[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28613334/a63bfa341a22fd65cec029d4baa4f7e3bd90e08b.png[/img]
Learn more [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/611040/view/4212627958610248012]HERE[/url]

[h2]Ready to jump on a hype train? Here we gooooo~~[/h2]
So far you had one and only goal in Tube Tycoon - to become the no. 1 channel in the world. Well… that could prove to be tiring and thus not everyone was always able to accomplish this colossal challenge.

[b]Here comes some help! :TTPROFESSOR:[/b]

Now from the very beginning you will have a full load of small challenges to complete. Meet a new mechanic (that will replace milestones) [b]→ 🎉 Tasks 🎉 [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28613334/4694c451d261ef8ee4709af61b80c7fb863f318e.gif[/img]

Think of them as side quests in your favorite RPG game - what do these quests have that everyone loves? Rewards! But these are a mystery in this case 🤫 Complete the tasks to receive varying rewards!

[h2]Talking about the story…[/h2]
…I am happy to confirm that Tube Tycoon v2 will now have a [b]FULL STORY LINE[/b]! Throughout your gameplay you will meet new characters, unlock new video types to record and most importantly learn more about the behind-the-scenes of TubeVideo platform!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28613334/5be3b7d0c185e13e278030e97a3068a82eb67a05.gif[/img]

[h2]“No way! I can’t wait for the next week’s feature reveal!”[/h2]
Don’t worry I hear you :TealFire: But as the good ol’ quote goes: “good things come to those who wait” so I hope to see you next week, keep that hype train running for a few more stations! 😄

.

notes.title: Editor beta - 0.3 update
notes.content:
Hey there!
Thank you all for great two weeks of testing Tube Tycoon Editor BETA 🎉 - We've gathered lots of feedback and ideas to make this tool even better!

Here are today's patch notes:
- Added scenario settings tab - edit appearance and preview it in [i]new game[/i] window
- Various graphic changes, changed left sidebar design for better readability
- Hover on event/video to [b]remove or duplicate[/b]
- Left sidebar is now scrollable - especially for larger files with lots of events and videos!
- When creating new event/video, first field is now focused to change it's name quickly and scrolls to top

That update does not bring a lot to editor, but changes a lot in code and prepares for future functionality!

[h2]How to roll in?[/h2]

To take part in the beta, you’ll need to to select beta branch in steam properties:
1. Open Steam, navigate to Tube Tycoon
2. Click settings icon and then “properties”
3. Select “beta testing” tab and from dropdown select “EditorBeta”
Now, the game should be updated with the new editor. PLEASE TAKE A NOTE, that this beta disables gameplay completely - if you’d like to play Tube Tycoon with all your previous saves, repeat the steps and and on the last step select “NONE”

[h2]Feedback[/h2]

You are welcome to leave a feedback of your experience with the editor. Please use this link and tell us what do you think about newest beta: [url=https://forms.gle/Ndf2k1TNciPFiKJQA]FEEDBACK FORM[/url]
A few players that will fill out the form and help with Tube Tycoon development, will get a chance to take part in closed beta tests of upcoming Tube Tycoon v2.0
Thanks everyone for your help 🔥

notes.title: Tube Tycoon Editor beta - test now!

Here it comes!

Now, you can try out new Tube Tycoon editor BETA and challenge yourself to create amazing scenario or game package 🎉

- package - mod that adds content to the game, can contain special events and new video types
- scenario - addition that allows player to start new game with custom game rules [i](soon included in the editor)[/I], special events and new video types

You are welcome to leave a feedback of your experience with the editor. Please use this link and tell us what do you think about newest beta: [url=https://forms.gle/o2WC4nNGVHRYJQmc6]FEEDBACK FORM[/url]

notes.title: Scenario editor coming to Tube Tycoon
notes.content:
Long time no see!

It's been a long time behind the curtains, but it is finally time to show you some stuff coming to Tube Tycoon in the near future! To start things of, we would like to tell you about the new [b]scenario editor[/b] - part of the Tube Tycoon 2.0 update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28613334/0cd089b9640ed3d3320a92af0aaa6193c427688d.png[/img]

With [b]scenario editor[/b] you'll be able to:
[list]
[*]Create scripted events based on many available triggers (like recording video or achieving certain number of subscribers)
[*]Design beautiful dialogs or chat windows to tell your story
[*]Create new video types to record
[*]Generate complex titles using build-in videos title generator
[*]And much more!
[*]Post to Steam Workshop and share your creations with others! (later update)
[/list]

And best of all - all of this you'll be able to test by yourself next week [b]on Tuesday (03.10.2020)[/b] in open beta! 

[h3]Quick Q&A:[/h3]
[b]> Who will be able to access beta of the editor?[/b]
[i]Everyone who purchased the game![/i]

[b]> Is there any new update to the game?[/b]
[i]Beta editor release does not updates the main Tube Tycoon game - but eventually it will be part of the new free 2.0 Tube Tycoon update.[/i]

[b]> How about reviving the Discord server?[/b]
[i]We are planning to do so this week![/i]

Thank you for creating great Tube Tycoon community, see you soon!

notes.title: Tube Tycoon Pro mode update is coming!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28613334/591bf5e7b1dbfd8f1646acd6c1ca47ab745581e5.png[/img]

Hello Tube Tycooners!

It’s been a few weeks since last Tube Tycoon update. I’m sorry you had to wait so long for this announcement
- trust me, working alone on the game is not an easy task and I needed some break ⛱


[h1]Pro Mode[/h1]
Ok, so you probably now ask:
[I]What is this new „Pro mode” mentioned in the header?[/I]

Based on your opinions, reviews and suggestions I decided to create [b]completely separate game mode[/b] from what you can find in Tube Tycoon currently. It will be more focused on time management, interactions with your fans and of course it will also bring beautiful new interface elements and visuals to make journey through TubeVideo even more pleasant to watch! I’ll be happy to share with you more details and first screenshots in a few weeks! If you have any features that you’d love to see in Tube Tycoon, be sure to suggest them on our Discord community!

[h1]Bug fixes update[/h1]

I’ve recently pushed new version v1.0.5 with bug fixes, Paytron fix and small redesign of the bottom bar.
Also expect v1.0.6 in the next 48h with some more bug fixes.

[h1]Discord community[/h1]

Join now [b]2500 Tube Tycooners[/b] on our [url=http://discord.gg/TubeTycoon]Discord server[/url]! Share your game experiences, tactics and suggestions for future updates. Also, if you’d like to ask me - Bionicl, the creator of the game - anything, that’s the best place to do so!

[b][url=http://discord.gg/TubeTycoon]Don’t hesitate and join now![/url][/b]

That’s it for this small update, I’m going back to work! See you soon in the future Tube Tycoon update posts.
